label_provenance: Loghub source Level mapped to P1–P5 (weak labels, not human-verified incident severity)
interpretation: Scores measure agreement with the supplied labels. A row split can share templates across train and test; it is not an unseen-template or unseen-source generalization test.
stacking: 3-fold stratified OOF within the training partition; TF-IDF is refit inside every fold
ensemble_policy: Fixed 50% equal-weight soft voting + 50% stacking; no test-set selection
feature_representation: text TF-IDF 1–2 grams; source metadata excluded
